name: ps-identity-accessors-panic-unscanned
body: Identity's accessors unit_name, unit_parent and script_parent index straight into the resolved map and panic on a path that was not scanned; only script_name returns an Option. Limit: callers must pass a scanned .ps1/.psm1 path, which finish and every current caller do. Upgrade by returning Option from all accessors when a caller can hold an unscanned path.
